story: Sam is a small boy in the kitchen. He hears a sound and finds a single toy chicken. The toy is hard and the situation is terrible. Most toys are soft, but this one is not. Mia helps the poor boy with milk.
title: The Toy Chicken
setting: A kitchen with a wooden floor.

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: a woman with long black hair and a green apron

sentences.en: Sam is a small boy in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 萨姆是厨房里的一名小男孩。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a small boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt, stands in a kitchen.

sentences.en: He hears a sound from the floor.
sentences.zh: 他听到地板上传来一个声音。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam looks down at the kitchen floor with a surprised face.

sentences.en: Someone is in the kitchen with him.
sentences.zh: 有人和他在一起，在厨房里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam looks around the kitchen looking for a person.

sentences.en: He sees a single toy on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他看到地板上有一个玩具。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam points to a small object on the kitchen floor.

sentences.en: The toy is a small white chicken.
sentences.zh: 这个玩具是一只白色的小鸡。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small, white plastic toy chicken lies on the floor.

sentences.en: It is so hard and not soft.
sentences.zh: 它非常坚硬，一点也不软。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam touches the hard white toy chicken.

sentences.en: Most toys are soft and nice.
sentences.zh: 大多数玩具都是又软又好的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam holds a soft teddy bear in his other hand.

sentences.en: This terrible sound was very loud.
sentences.zh: 这个糟糕的声音非常大。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam covers his ears with his hands.

sentences.en: Please help the poor boy with milk.
sentences.zh: 请帮助这个喝牛奶的可怜男孩。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a woman with long black hair and a green apron, gives a glass of milk to Sam.
